fusions.name: Harrying Snap
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Point the Pack
fusions.desc: A strike on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Grass Hush
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Poacher's Lurcher
fusions.desc: Calls a lurcher familiar that fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it strikes is slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.
